visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Capital Vowels Counted as Consonants
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Education has 5 vowels and 4 consonants, but the program prints vowels=4 consonants=5.

solution.explanation: The comparisons only list lower-case vowels, so the capital E of Education fails them and falls into the consonant branch. Convert each character with tolower before comparing.
